taskDescription: Drag each word into the correct blank to complete the statements about metabolic hubs.
textField: Three of the four metabolic hubs are glucose-6-phosphate, *pyruvate* and *acetyl-CoA*; the fourth is the pool of TCA-cycle intermediates. The step from the second to the third hub is *irreversible*, and each turn of the TCA cycle loses two CO2 that match acetyl-CoA's two carbons, so even-chain fatty acids supply no net *glucose*.

overallFeedback.feedback: Pyruvate dehydrogenase irreversibly converts pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, and acetyl-CoA's two carbons are matched by the two CO2 lost in each turn of the TCA cycle, so acetyl-CoA supplies no net TCA-cycle intermediates. Any fuel that enters metabolism only as acetyl-CoA (including even-chain fatty acids) therefore cannot support net glucose synthesis through this route — a rule with direct clinical importance in starvation and diabetes.
